issues_before.message: Evidence snippet not found: lm75a page 5 -> Temperature accuracy ±2 °C from -25 °C to +100 °C

issues_after.message: Evidence snippet not found: lm75a page 5 -> Temperature accuracy ±2 °C from -25 °C to +100 °C

repaired_evidence_spans.snippet: the other four MSB bits of the address data are preset to '1001'
only 11 significant bits should be used, and the 5 LSB bits of the LS byte are zero and should be ignored.
the temp-to-digital conversion is executed every 100 ms
At power-up, the Pointer value is equal to 0 and the Temp register is selected
If the Temp data MSB bit D10 = 0 then the temperature is positive and Temp value ( ° C) = + (Temp data) * 0.125 ° C
If the Temp data MSB bit D10 = 1 then the temperature is negative and Temp  value ( ° C) = - (2's complement of Temp data) * 0.125 ° C
only 9 significant bits should be used and the 7 LSB bits of the LS byte are equal to zero and should be ignored.
At power-up, the device is put into normal operation mode, the Tos is set to 80 ° C, the Thyst is set to 75 ° C
SCL clock period 2.5 µs
SCL HIGH pulse width 0.6 µs
SCL LOW pulse width 1.3 µs
Start Hold time 100 ns
Data set-up time 100 ns
Data hold time 0 ns
Stop set-up time 100 ns
Configuration Register . Contains a single 8-bit data byte.
Temperature Register . Contains two 8-bit data bytes.
Over-temp Shutdown threshold Register . Contains two 8-bit data bytes.
Hysteresis Register . Contains two 8-bit data bytes.
the three LSB bits of the device 7-bit address
the input pins, SCL, SDA, A2-A0, are not internally biased
OS output is an open-drain output
Tos & Thyst limits must be selected so that Tos temp value > Thyst temp value
Fault queue is defined as the number of faults that must occur consecutively
When the power supply voltage is dropped below the device power-on reset level of about 1.9 V
Temperature accuracy ±2 °C from -25 °C to +100 °C
Temperature resolution 0.125 °C
Supply quiescent current Normal mode: I2C inactive 100 µA
Supply quiescent current Shut-down mode 3.5 µA
Pin-for-pin replacement for industry standard LM75
